title: umsf-ble-firmware: ESP32 firmware for dataset acquisition assemblies and merging nodes into a Bluetooth channel

creators.name: Beketova, Gulzhanat
creators.affiliation: Almaty University of Energy and Communications

description:
ESP32 firmware for the UMSF evidence-aware multisensor monitoring pilot (project P2 of the companion deposit to Evidence-Aware Multisensor Monitoring for Critical Infrastructure Incident Support, 2026): a personnel node (MAX30102, DS18B20, MPU-6050, help button, optional GSR; one feature record per 10 s), a stationary building-state node (MPU-6050 200 Hz ±16 g, BMP280, MQ-2, microphone, PIR, SOS; local page at 192.168.4.1) and a BLE gateway that merges up to three nodes into one ordered uplink stream with per-source identity, publishing JSON records over MQTT QoS 1 with mutually authenticated TLS. Records are released from RAM buffers only by an application acknowledgement after the site agent's durable commit.

All non-hardware logic (protocol v1.0 codec, CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE, fragmentation with 512 B limit and 2 s timeout, ring buffer, feature extraction, uncalibrated detectors, link supervision) is portable C/C++ with host unit tests; test vectors are included. Evidence boundary: the ESP32 firmware images were not compiled and are untested on hardware in this release; heart rate is a flagged synthetic test field or null, SpO2 is null, thresholds are uncalibrated, the local composite possible_impact_local is unverified and never a strike attribution; the target COSE profile and the patent No. 38233 keystream method are not implemented. Not a certified safety or medical device.
notes: Uncompiled and untested on hardware; see README evidence boundaries.
